_about: Ground types of the maps. walk: the hero can walk on it. color: the color of the top block (a palette name). under: the color of the block under the top. slow: the speed factor on it. grows: a prop that grows on every second cell of this type (the bamboo of the hedge). face: the colors of the blocks under the top, by a seeded rule for each block (a face of stone: the ink draws the cracks where two colors meet); the blocks are rock.
